title: ReBoT-MiCS: Reliability-Aware Bounding Time for Enhancing Timing Behavior of Embedded Mixed-Criticality Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.22588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In Mixed-Criticality (MC) systems, considering multiple Worst-Case Execution Times (WCETs) for the same task, corresponding to different system operation modes, presents a fundamental challenge in MC system design. Identifying suitable WCETs for lower (LO) criticality system operational modes is inherently difficult. Tight low WCET values may trigger frequent mode switches that degrade Quality-of-Service (QoS) by dropping/degrading the lower-criticality tasks and reducing their functionality. However, more conservative values reduce resource efficiency. Moreover, low WCET selection affects exposure assumptions under the adopted transient-fault model, which is used in reliability-aware scheduling analysis. tldr: 该论文提出ReBoT-MiCS方法，通过可靠性感知的低关键性WCET约束时间确定机制，在联合权衡QoS、模式切换与可靠性约束的前提下，增强嵌入式混合关键性系统的时序行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReBoT-MiCS, a reliability-aware bounding time approach for determining low-criticality WCETs that enhances the timing behavior of embedded mixed-criticality systems by jointly balancing QoS, mode switching, and reliability constraints.
